# Pele

Unmodified `dist/pele.global.js` and `LICENSE` from the MIT-licensed npm package
`pele@1.9.0`, https://github.com/obsidianmd/pele.

Source archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/pele/-/pele-1.9.0.tgz
The adapter embeds the global bundle at compile time; installed Grove needs no
Node, npm, CDN, network, browser or filesystem access to render diagrams.

To update, download an exact npm version, verify the archive integrity from its
registry metadata, extract these two files, record their SHA-256 below, and run
the Pele adapter and Mermaid rasterizer tests before changing the pin.

SHA-256:

